name: cut-with-a-redundant-tool
why: A tool inside another tool of the same cut meets the material but removes nothing of its own. Checked one tool at a time this was refused in both orders, for two different wrong reasons — 'removed nothing, meets nowhere' after the slot, 'sealed a void' before it. Closed form: 40·40·10 − 10·10·10 = 15000 mm³, area 2·(1600 − 100) + 4·400 + 4·100 = 5000 mm², and the floor is 1600 − 100.
